definition_json.description: GH #3749 / REQ-712, docs/assets/stock-workflow-documents.md sections 1.4 and 9.1, decision 0078 D5. The header of a stock receipt document. It is written only by module stock (managed type). document_id is the id of the versioned document of Letflow.Documents (decision 0056) that carries the state, the gap-free number and the issued time: no number, status, posted_at, posted_by or reversed_by_entry is stored here (they are read from the versioned document). org_unit_id is the issuing org unit (queried; the scope column of decision 0076 R7). event_time is the time of the receipt, ISO 8601 with offset, stored in UTC. location_id, responsible_id and counterparty_id are record ids of modules locations, org and catalog_items (other packs: no foreign key; the module checks them at issue). After issue nothing of the header changes.
definition_json.name: stock_receipt

definition_json.description: GH #3749 / REQ-712, docs/assets/stock-workflow-documents.md sections 1.4 and 9.3. One line of a stock receipt. header_id is the record_id of the stock_receipt header (not the document id); the foreign_keys entry fk_stock_receipt_line_header_id promotes it to a uuid column with ON DELETE RESTRICT (inert on the soft-delete path). org_unit_id is the header's value copied by the module (queried; the scope column of decision 0076 R7, so a scoped read can filter lines). line_no is the position 1..n. quantity is an exact decimal (precision 24, scale 9, decimal_strict). catalog_item_id, catalog_uom_id and catalog_lot_id are record ids of module catalog_items (another pack: no foreign key; the module checks them at issue). GH #3747 / REQ-714: unit_price and line_value are optional exact decimals kept on the document only (never posted to the ledger). Written only by module stock; after issue nothing of a line changes.
definition_json.name: stock_receipt_line

definition_json.description: GH #3775 / REQ-725, decision 0079 sections D1 to D4. The header of an opening balance document. It is written only by module stock (managed type). document_id is the id of the versioned document of Letflow.Documents (decision 0056) that carries the state, the gap-free number and the issued time: no number, status, posted_at or posted_by is stored here. There is no event_time: the ledger stamps the posting time as the event time (REQ-726), and the real receipt date is a field of each line. org_unit_id is the issuing org unit (queried; the scope column of decision 0076 R7). external_ref_system and external_ref_id are an optional pair that names the document for the xlsx import (decision 0079 D5); their uniqueness among live documents is checked by the module, not by a table constraint (a soft-deleted row would keep the pair taken). After issue nothing of the header changes.
definition_json.name: stock_opening

definition_json.description: GH #3775 / REQ-725, decision 0079 section D2. One line of an opening balance document. header_id is the record_id of the stock_opening header (not the document id); the foreign_keys entry fk_stock_opening_line_header_id promotes it to a uuid column with ON DELETE RESTRICT (inert on the soft-delete path). org_unit_id is the header's value copied by the module (queried; the scope column of decision 0076 R7). line_no is the position 1..n. location_id and responsible_id are record ids of modules locations and org, catalog_item_id, catalog_uom_id and catalog_lot_id of module catalog_items (other packs: no foreign key; the module checks them at issue). quantity is an exact decimal (precision 24, scale 9, decimal_strict). received_on is the real receipt date of the stock, a field only: it never becomes the event time. unit_price and line_value are optional exact decimals kept on the document only (never posted to the ledger). external_ref_system and external_ref_id are an optional pair for the xlsx import. Written only by module stock; after issue nothing of a line changes.
definition_json.name: stock_opening_line

definition_json.description: GH #3770 / REQ-721, docs/assets/stock-workflow-documents.md sections 1.4 and 9.1. The header of a transfer of stock between two locations (and possibly org units and responsible employees). Written only by module stock (managed type). document_id is the id of the versioned document of Letflow.Documents (decision 0056) that carries the state, the gap-free number and the issued time: nothing of that is stored here. org_unit_id is the filing org unit (queried; the scope column of decision 0076 R7): the from unit for a transfer or hand over, the unit the stock goes back to for a return. event_time is ISO 8601 with offset, stored in UTC. The from_* and to_* fields are record ids of modules org and locations (other packs: no foreign key; the module checks them at issue). After issue nothing of the header changes. No counterparty, price or reason field.
definition_json.name: stock_transfer

definition_json.description: REQ-700 / GH #3737. The header of a count order (inventory taking): one org unit, a kind (full or selective), the planned period, the chair, a status and the issued document. status is draft, ordered, counting, counted, signed, posted or cancelled. org_unit_id is the scope column (decision 0076 R7). Master references (org unit, employee) are record ids checked in code (0076 R6), not foreign keys. cut_off_at and cutoff_seq are filled when the count is opened and sheet_document_id when it is closed (REQ-701).
definition_json.name: count_order

definition_json.description: REQ-700 / GH #3737. One root location of a count order (the order covers the root and every location below it). count_order_id is a real foreign key onto count_order; org_unit_id is a copy of the header's, the scope column.
definition_json.name: count_order_scope

definition_json.description: REQ-700 / GH #3737. One member (not the chair) of the commission of a count order. count_order_id is a real foreign key onto count_order; org_unit_id is a copy of the header's, the scope column.
definition_json.name: count_commission_member

definition_json.description: REQ-701 / GH #3736. One line of the count sheet of a count order: a ledger balance key as of the cut-off (kind stock, book_quantity from the stock ledger) or a surplus line the commission added (kind surplus, book_quantity 0). count_order_id is a real foreign key onto count_order; org_unit_id is a copy of the header's, the scope column (decision 0076 R7). counted_quantity is empty until the commission has counted the line. Quantities are exact decimals (precision 24, scale 9, decimal_strict). Master references are record ids checked in code (0076 R6).
definition_json.name: count_sheet_line

definition_json.description: REQ-701 / GH #3736. One entry of the append-only log of a count order: who typed which quantity on which sheet line and when. entry_no is 1..n per order (a total order for the log and its cursor). No function of module stock updates or deletes an entry. count_order_id is a real foreign key onto count_order; org_unit_id is a copy of the header's, the scope column (decision 0076 R7). method is typed now; the scanner value comes with REQ-720.
definition_json.name: count_entry

definition_json.description: GH #3748 / REQ-713, decision 0073 (Consequences, cost note), docs/assets/stock-workflow-documents.md section 9.2. The bookkeeping record that says a stock document was posted (mark posted) or reversed (mark reversed). It is written only by the write handlers post_document and reverse_document of module stock, in the same transaction as the ledger entry (HandlerWrites.create/3 and post/3). document_id is the id of the versioned document, document_type its type key, version_no the issued version, org_unit_id the issuing org unit (queried; the scope column of decision 0076 R7), reason_code the reversal reason (set on a reversed mark only). The unique constraint uq_stock_posting_mark_doc_mark allows one posted and one reversed mark per document: a second completion of a posting for the same document violates it, so the whole completion transaction rolls back before any ledger write.
definition_json.name: stock_posting_mark
